title: Pill Shape
description: Raymarch a lit capsule. The canvas runs from -1 to 1. Camera: ro = (0, 0, 3), rd = normalize(vec3(uv, -1.0)). March up to 64 steps with t += d, hit when d < 0.001, give up when t > 10. The scene is one capsule between a = (-0.8, -0.5, 0) and b = (0.8, 0.5, 0) with radius 0.35. Capsule distance: pa = p - a, ba = b - a, h = clamp(dot(pa, ba) / dot(ba, ba), 0.0, 1.0), d = length(pa - ba * h) - 0.35. Take the normal from central differences with eps 0.001. Light direction l = normalize(vec3(0.7, 0.6, 0.5)), diffuse = max(dot(n, l), 0.0). A hit is green (0.35, 0.80, 0.55) * (0.15 + 0.85 * diffuse), plus a rim light: v = normalize(ro - p), rim = pow(1.0 - max(dot(n, v), 0.0), 3.0), add (0.8, 1.0, 0.9) * rim * 0.35. A miss is (0.05, 0.09, 0.07).
